title: Pan-Seared Wagyu with Japanese-Style Bowl
description: A simple and elegant dish featuring the richness of Wagyu beef, served with a side of steamed vegetables and Japanese-style rice bowl.

ingredients.name: Wagyu beef strip loin
ingredients.notes: preferably with a marbling score of 6 or higher

instructions: 1. Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook Japanese rice according to package instructions.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sake, and sesame oil to make a marinade.
3. Place the Wagyu beef strip loin in a shallow dish and brush both sides with the marinade.
4. Heat a skillet over high heat and sear the Wagyu beef for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
5. Let the Wagyu beef rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
6. While the Wagyu beef is cooking, steam broccoli florets in a steamer basket until tender.
7. To assemble the Japanese-style rice bowl, place a scoop of cooked Japanese rice on a plate, followed by sliced Wagyu beef, steamed broccoli, and a sprinkle of nori seaweed.
8. Season with bowl nori seasoning and garnish with green onions.
